structured_output.summary: The diff implements Iterator.prototype.reduce in its own file only, following the spec steps in order with each step kept as a comment. Checked against the spec: TypeError on non-object this (step 2); the non-callable reducer path closes the iterator with a TypeError completion via ops::iterator_close and returns its result (step 4); GetIteratorDirect is called with ? (step 5); "initialValue not present" is detected via args.len() < 2, so an explicit undefined counts as present (step 6); counter starts at 1 or +0 (steps 6c/7b); the loop uses ? on IteratorStepValue, returns the accumulator when done, calls reducer with (accumulator, value, counter) and this undefined, closes the iterator on abrupt completion via if_abrupt_close_iterator, then updates accumulator and counter (step 8). The 2^53 guard is the spec's NOTE and matches IEEE addition behaviour. No errors are swallowed, no values are made up, no test-specific branches exist, and nothing outside the ticket file changed. Gate: build and clippy ok, 48 new passes, no regressions. Not a finding, but unverified from the diff: the iterator record's next_method is not explicitly rooted across the reducer call, and the step-4 error object is unrooted during IteratorClose. Both depend on helper internals I cannot see, and GC rooting is not one of the questions asked.
